title: Duetto
subtitle: Two cuts in conversation — one still, one restless.

stone.origin: Two cuts. Neither one louder than the other. The emerald holds its light quietly — clean lines, parallel faces, still. The round throws it in every direction at once.

description: Two cuts, neither louder than the other. The emerald holds its light quietly: clean lines, parallel planes, a stillness that asks to be looked into rather than at. The round throws its light in every direction at once, restless and bright. The necklace sets them in deliberate contrast, a duet in which each cut does what the other cannot, and the tension between stillness and sparkle becomes the whole idea. Carried in eighteen-karat white gold, close at the throat.
